name: stationarity
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 随机过程的特定统计特征对时间或位置平移保持不变的性质。
usage_overview: 在轨道几何退化的随机过程分析中，平稳性用作谱描述的重要前提，涉及所考察的统计特征在时间或位置平移下是否保持不变。

complete_examples.text: Instead, a statistical and mathematical model is proposed to randomly estimate the evolution of track irregularities with a guarantee of the stationarity of track geometries.

However, the most of the previous researches are unable to guarantee the frequency characteristics and stationarity of track geometric evolutions and consequently, keeping a robust assessment of long-term system behaviours.

P017.title: A spectral evolution model for track geometric degradation in train–track long-term dynamics
P017.label: Xu等（2020）
